name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme
description: Central Sector scheme awarding scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest dropouts at Class 8 and encourage secondary education.

benefit.description: ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000 per month) credited directly to the student's bank account through DBT from Class 9 to Class 12.

general: Must be studying as regular student in Class 9 in Government, Local Body, or Govt-aided school
Must have secured at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST) in Class 8 examination
Must have qualified the State Level NMMSS Selection Examination
otherConditions: Students of Kendriya Vidyalayas, Navodaya Vidyalayas, Sainik Schools, and residential schools run by State Govts are not eligible

eligibilityChecks.question: Are you studying in a Government, Local Body, or Government-aided school?
Have you appeared and qualified the NMMSS Class 8 selection test?
Is your parental annual income ₹3,50,000 or less from all sources?

requiredDocuments: Income Certificate issued by competent Revenue Authority (Tahsildar / MRO)
Bank Account Passbook (joint or single in student's name, Aadhaar seeded)
Bonafide / Enrolment Certificate from current school
applicationProcess: Register and create an applicant account on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Select 'National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme' under Ministry of Education
Fill student details, school U-DISE code, and NMMSS exam roll number
Upload verified income certificate, bank details, and previous marks card
Submit application and submit physical copy to School Headmaster / Principal for NSP verification
School and District Nodal Officer verify online on the NSP portal

applicationWindow.details: July to October of the academic year on National Scholarship Portal (NSP)

ministry: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education
aiContext: Provides ₹12,000/year to students in Class 9-12 from government/aided schools who cleared NMMS test and family income ≤ ₹3.5 Lakh. Applied via National Scholarship Portal.

faqs.question: Can private unaided school students apply?
faqs.answer: No, NMMSS is exclusively for students studying in Government, Local Body, and Government-aided schools.

faqs.question: How do I renew the scholarship in Class 10, 11, and 12?
faqs.answer: Apply for 'Renewal' on NSP every year after passing Class 9/10/11 with minimum 55% marks (50% for SC/ST).

name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC / ST Students
description: Centrally Sponsored Scheme providing financial assistance to Scheduled Caste & Scheduled Tribe students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to complete their education.

benefit.amount: Full Tuition Fee + Academic Allowance up to ₹13,500/year
benefit.description: 100% non-refundable compulsory fees reimbursed to institution, plus monthly maintenance allowance (up to ₹13,500/year for hostellers, ₹7,000 for day scholars).

general: Must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST)
Must be pursuing post-matriculation courses (Class 11, 12, ITI, Diploma, Degree, PG, Ph.D.) in recognized institutions
Must have passed previous qualifying examination
otherConditions: Candidate should not be in full-time employment during studies

eligibilityChecks.question: Do you possess a valid SC or ST Caste Certificate issued by the competent authority?
Are you enrolled in Class 11, 12, Diploma, Graduation, or Post-Graduation?
Is your total family annual income ₹2,50,000 or below?

requiredDocuments: Caste Certificate (SC/ST) with digital bar code
College Admission Fee Receipt & Bonafide Certificate
applicationProcess: Visit the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) or your State e-Pass Portal
Register using Aadhaar and mobile number
Select Post Matric Scholarship for SC or ST Students
Upload caste, income, admission receipt, and bank passbook
Submit application online and forward to College Nodal Officer for verification

applicationWindow.details: July to November of every academic year

ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Ministry of Tribal Affairs
aiContext: Provides full non-refundable tuition fee + maintenance allowance up to ₹13,500/year for SC/ST students in college/diploma with family income ≤ ₹2.5 Lakh.

faqs.question: Is there any restriction on course type?
faqs.answer: All recognized post-secondary courses like Intermediate, B.A., B.Sc., B.Tech, MBBS, MBA, ITI, Polytechnic, and Ph.D. are covered.

faqs.question: Can I receive this scholarship along with another state scholarship?
faqs.answer: No, a student can hold only one government scholarship for the same course.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
description: Scheme implemented by AICTE aimed at providing assistance for advancement of girls pursuing technical education (Degree and Diploma).

benefit.description: ₹50,000 per year for every year of study as a lump sum amount towards college fees, purchase of computer, books, stationeries, and equipment.

general: Must be a girl student admitted to 1st year of Degree/Diploma course or 2nd year through lateral entry
Maximum two girls per family are eligible
otherConditions: Family income must not exceed ₹8 Lakh per annum

eligibilityChecks.question: Are you a female student enrolled in an AICTE-approved engineering/polytechnic college?
Are you admitted in 1st year of Degree/Diploma or 2nd year lateral entry in the current academic year?
Is your total annual family income ₹8,00,000 or below?

requiredDocuments: Tuition Fee Receipt for current year
Income Certificate (issued by Tahsildar / Revenue Authority)
applicationProcess: Visit National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Select AICTE Schemes -> Pragati Scholarship Scheme For Girl Students (Technical Degree/Diploma)
Fill student profile, academic roll numbers, and parent details
Upload admission letter, income proof, and bank passbook
Submit and have college Principal verify on NSP portal

applicationWindow.details: August to December on National Scholarship Portal

dependsOn: AICTE Merit List generation and NSP verification

ministry: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education
aiContext: Provides ₹50,000/year to girl students studying in AICTE-approved B.Tech/Diploma programs with family income ≤ ₹8 Lakh. Max 2 girls per family.

faqs.question: Can degree lateral entry students apply?
faqs.answer: Yes, girls admitted directly into 2nd year through lateral entry are eligible.

faqs.question: What if my family income is ₹7 Lakh?
faqs.answer: You are eligible, as the upper income limit for Pragati is ₹8 Lakh per annum.

name: Jagananna Vidya Deevena & Vasathi Deevena
beneficiaries: Polytechnic / ITI / Degree / BTech / Pharmacy / MBA Students
description: Andhra Pradesh government flagship scheme providing 100% full tuition fee reimbursement (Vidya Deevena) and boarding/mess assistance of up to ₹20,000/year (Vasathi Deevena).

benefit.description: Complete fee deposited into the mother's bank account every quarter, plus ₹10,000 (ITI), ₹15,000 (Polytechnic), or ₹20,000 (Degree/Engineering) for hostel/mess.

general: Must be a resident of Andhra Pradesh
Must be enrolled in Polytechnic, ITI, Degree, Engineering, Medicine, or PG courses in recognized institutions
otherConditions: Family must not own a four-wheeler (except taxi/tractor)
Wet land < 10 acres or dry land < 25 acres or total < 25 acres

eligibilityChecks.question: Are you a permanent resident student of Andhra Pradesh?
Do you maintain at least 75% college biometric attendance?
Is your family total annual income ₹2,50,000 or less?

requiredDocuments: Integrated Caste & Income Certificate (issued by Tahsildar)
College Admission Allotment Letter & Fee Structure
applicationProcess: College registers the student on the Jnanabhumi / Navasakam portal
Welfare and Education Assistant (WEA) of Village/Ward Secretariat conducts physical field verification
Mother's biometric authentication at Village Secretariat
Eligible list published after social audit in Grama/Ward Sachivalayam
Direct Benefit Transfer credited into mother's account every quarter

applicationWindow.details: Enrolment open at start of each semester

dependsOn: Village Secretariat verification and college attendance upload

ministry: Department of Higher Education & Social Welfare, Government of Andhra Pradesh
aiContext: Andhra Pradesh scheme providing 100% college tuition fee reimbursement + ₹20,000/yr hostel aid deposited directly into the mother's bank account for families with income ≤ ₹2.5 Lakh and 75% attendance.

faqs.question: Whose bank account receives the payment?
faqs.answer: The scheme mandates that all fee reimbursement amounts are credited directly into the student's mother's Aadhaar-seeded bank account.

faqs.question: Is attendance mandatory?
faqs.answer: Yes, 75% student biometric attendance in college is compulsory to receive quarterly fee disbursements.
